subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Defunct
solution: The correct answer is **Option 2 i.e. Extant.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • The given word "**Defunct**" refers to something that is no longer existing or functioning.(कुछ ऐसा जो अब अस्तित्व में नहीं है या कार्यशील नहीं है) • **Example:** Many of the factories in the old part of the city are now defunct. • The correct option "**Extant**" means still in existence; not lost or destroyed. (अभी भी अस्तित्व में है; खोया या नष्ट नहीं हुआ) • **Example:** The museum has a few extant pieces of medieval furniture. Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Extant**. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Stoicism**: A philosophy that teaches the development of self-control and fortitude as a means of overcoming destructive emotions.(एक दर्शन जो आत्मसंयम और धैर्य का विकास सिखाता है) • **Convoluted**: Something that is very complicated and difficult to understand. (कुछ ऐसा जो बहुत जटिल और समझने में कठिन है।) • **Redundant**: Exceeding what is necessary or normal; superfluous.(जो आवश्यक या सामान्य है उससे अधिक होना; ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा) 39:Ta9e, The **correct answer **is **Option 1 **i.e. **Emanate**.
